_comment: Copy to tools/comfy/engines.local.json (not committed) and point each engine at a workflow exported from ComfyUI with 'Save (API Format)'. bind is optional: add it only if the auto-binding cannot find an input, as "<node id>.<input name>". ltx: an LTX-2.5 (image-to-)video workflow; the pipeline sets prompt, negative, seed, size, frame count (8n+1) and the start image.
